attr.title: Halo: Combat Evolved
attr.desc: The Master Chief's first fight, on the Covenant's ringworld. A native port of the Xbox game's decompilation, with no emulation.
attr.desc_md: The Master Chief's first fight, on the Covenant's ringworld. A native port of the Xbox game's decompilation ([OpenCE](https://github.com/OpenCommunityEdition/OpenCE)), with no emulation. More at [halo-ce-anbernic-rg35xx](https://github.com/kirklandsig/halo-ce-anbernic-rg35xx).
attr.inst: Copy your disc image of Halo: Combat Evolved for the Xbox (an .iso file) into ports/halo. The first start copies the game's maps out of it, which takes a few minutes; the image can then be deleted. The PC version's files do not work.
